content.text:
I made a second fix that should cover the main case my first one missed, but I couldn't test it. I couldn't type-check it either: TypeScript isn't installed in the project, and the sandbox blocked downloading it.

**Why the first fix wasn't enough:** when a meeting mode like Team Meet is active, the recap is built from that mode's sections, using the descriptions saved with your mode. Team Meet's action-items section says *"All action items that were said **I** would do after the meeting."* So "Priya will send the contract" was left out because the task belongs to Priya, not you. The general rule I added before was too weak to override that.

**What I changed:** in `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`, any section whose title looks like action items, follow-ups or next steps now gets an extra instruction added when the prompt is built. It tells the model to:
- write each item as `Owner: task (due date)`
- include tasks for **any** participant, not just you
- keep tasks with no deadline and write "(no date given)" instead
- never invent a date

Because this is added when the prompt is built, it also covers modes you've already saved.

**Two things to check:**
- **Rebuild and restart the app.** These files run in the app's background process, so a running copy keeps the old prompts until you restart it.
- **Sales and Recruiting modes are affected too.** Their action-items sections were also written to cover only your own tasks. With this change they'll list everyone's tasks as well. If you'd rather keep those two to your own tasks, I can limit the "any participant" part to Team Meet and the general recap.

If it still drops the item after a restart, send me the console line that starts with `[MeetingPersistence] Raw LLM summary response`. It shows whether the model left the task out or something later removed it.
